name: jd-outreach
description: Paste a job description. Get a fit verdict, tailored CV, hiring manager contact, and outreach email — all matched to your voice and background.

slots.label: Base CV
slots.description: Your master CV in Markdown. Every tailored CV the app produces is derived from this.
slots.prompt: Paste your CV in Markdown (or plain text). Include every role, metric, and tool you want the tailoring engine to draw from.

slots.label: Career facts
slots.description: Hard facts the AI must never contradict: exact titles, company names, date ranges, key numbers.
slots.prompt:
List your career facts — one per line. Example:
  - Title at Acme Corp: Senior Product Manager, Jan 2021–Mar 2024
  - Grew activation rate from 34% to 61% (Q3 2022)
The model treats these as ground truth and will not invent variations.

slots.label: Email writing sample
slots.description: A real email you wrote. The app copies your sentence rhythm, formality level, and word choices when drafting outreach.
slots.prompt: Paste a professional email you've written. Subject line through sign-off. It should reflect how you sound when you're trying to make a good impression.

slots.label: Intro / cover paragraph sample
slots.description: Optional: a cover letter opening or intro paragraph in your voice.
slots.prompt: Paste an intro paragraph or cover letter opening you've used. If you skip this, the app uses your email sample as the voice reference.

slots.label: Email signature
slots.description: Appended verbatim to every outreach email the app drafts.
slots.prompt: Paste your email signature — name, title, phone, LinkedIn, etc.

slots.label: Story rules (optional)
slots.description: Personal rules that override the default coaching standard for your interview stories.
slots.prompt: Any personal rules for your interview stories? E.g. 'Never mention the 2019 layoff' or 'Always lead with the Payments platform story for fintech roles'. Skip to use the defaults.

slots.label: Background ties (employers, schools, cities)
slots.description: Used to find common ground between you and a hiring manager — shared employer, school, or city.
slots.prompt: Paste your ties.json — see profile.example/ties.json for the format. List every employer, school, and city associated with your career.

slots.label: Your name
slots.description: Used as the prefix on every PDF the app generates (e.g. Jane_Doe_Acme_Director.pdf).

slots.label: Anthropic API key
slots.description: Powers the fit check, CV tailoring, and email drafting. Get one at console.anthropic.com.

slots.label: Hunter.io API key
slots.description: Finds hiring manager email addresses. Without it, the app falls back to web search only.
slots.fallback_note: Without this key, hiring manager email lookup uses web search only — slower and less precise.
